open_prs.author: mastermindxryan
open_prs.body:
## R04-B1 — `flow_pulse`: a board whose reads failed is `read_failed`, never `no_data`

**What `read_failed` is.** A fastpath board where every read raised (or the file was absent / unreadable / had no time column) used to publish as `mode="no_data"` — the same label as a genuine quiet board (every read succeeded and found zero bars today). The dead-man and the operator journal could not tell a provider/cache failure from zero activity. After this PR:

- `mode = "fastpath"` when at least one row has `bars_today > 0` (unchanged; failed rows stay visible).
- `mode = "read_failed"` when no row has data and at least one row carries an `error` (NEW).
- `mode = "no_data"` when no row has data and no row carries an `error` (a genuine quiet board — every read succeeded and found zero today).

**A quiet board stays `no_data`.** The fix does not collapse successful empty reads into a failure state; only the rows that actually raised flip the mode.

**Coverage numbers and every consumer are unchanged.** `with_bars`/`n_tickers` arithmetic, `n_universe`, and the `n_universe`-denominator semantics already treat a failed row (`bars_today: None`, `error: <class>`) as not-resolved — confirmed against:
- `scripts/vps_live_orchestrator.py::flow_pulse_error` (rejects any `mode != "fastpath"`; new mode flows through the same branch as `no_data`).
- `scripts/check_vps_live_health.py` (`with_bars = int(row.get("bars_today") or 0) > 0`).
- `app/main.py::status()` (same rule).
- `templates/intraday_flow.html.j2` / `site/intraday_flow.html` (`Number(p.bars_today || 0) > 0`).
- `engine/entry_radar/producers/live_flow.py::read_flow_pulse` (iterates `rvol_tod`; a row without it contributes nothing).

**The only new top-level field is `n_failed`**, placed next to `n_universe`. No new mode beyond `read_failed`; no retry; no fallback read; no cache; no env var or config knob.

**Loader truth, fastpath only.** `_load_intraday_bars` gains a keyword-only `strict: bool = False` parameter. `strict=False` (default) returns `None` on absent/unreadable so the nightly/baseline callers (`_adv20_and_curve`, `_atr14`) keep their lenient semantics — they call without `strict` and are unchanged. `strict=True` raises three new module-level exceptions:

- `IntradayBarsAbsent(FileNotFoundError)` — file does not exist.
- `IntradayBarsUnreadable(OSError)` — file exists but cannot be decoded (chained `raise ... from e`).
- `IntradayBarsNoClock(ValueError)` — frame was read successfully but has no time column.

`_today_bars` calls the loader with `strict=True` and raises `IntradayBarsNoClock` itself when the frame has no clock column. The existing `except Exception` in `_run_fastpath` records `type(e).__name__` as the row's `error`; the new classes flow through that path unchanged.

**Lastgood sidecar unchanged.** Still written only when `has_data` is true; a `read_failed` board never overwrites lastgood. A new summary `log.warning` fires once per run when `n_failed > 0`, naming `n_failed`, `len(universe)`, and the resolved mode.
